title: Our end-to-end rules
question: Keep it, sharpen it, or strike it? Add the rule that is missing.

cards.text: Every test checks something a user can see.
Locators by role, label or test id. CSS only with a reason in the pull request.
No waitForTimeout in a test that is meant to stay.
If the failure does not need a browser, the test does not either.
Nobody reruns a failed pipeline test before reading its trace.
Stub what you do not own. Test what you own for real, at least once per pipeline.
Each test creates the data it needs and removes it afterwards.
A flaky result is a ticket, not a retry.
The pipeline and the laptops run the same pinned image.
